ei.title: The Power of COLORS in Movies
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart. Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience. Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash. Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much happier. Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① using → used: 'can be + 과거분사'의 수동태이므로 used

② made: 'they are intentionally made'에서 색상 선택이 '만들어지는' 것이라 수동태 과거분사 made가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ evoke: 'use color to add richness ~ and evoke specific emotions'에서 to add와 and로 이어지는 병렬이라 동사원형 evoke가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ get: 'colors get a film’s message across'에서 주어 colors(복수)에 맞는 복수 동사 get이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

det.korean: ④ represent → representing: 'while (also) + -ing'의 분사 병렬이므로 representing
det.analysis:
① who: 'a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews'에서 선행사가 사람(businessman)이라 주격 관계대명사 who가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② chose: 'the director chose one particular thing'에서 과거의 일을 말하므로 과거형 chose가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ represent → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'The young girl represents innocence while also ___ the violence'에서 'while (they are) also ___ing'로 이어지는 분사 구문이에요. 앞의 represents와 동시 동작을 분사(-ing)로 나타내므로 representing으로 써야 해요. represent로 쓰면 형태가 어긋나 틀려요. ❌ represent는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: while (also) + 분사(-ing): while also representing(동시에 나타내면서)

감독은 영화 전체를 컬러로 촬영하여 소녀의 붉은 외투를 강조했다.
강렬한 색상의 대비는 감독이 나치의 잔혹성을 강력하게 상징하도록 해 주었다.

questions.passage: Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors'에서 마을이 '흑백', 마법 세계가 '다양한 색'이므로 뒤바뀐 서술이라 불일치

✅ ② 본문 'The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ③ 본문 'the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in'에서 색 차이로 '구분할 수 있다'고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ④ 본문 'Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic'에서 '몰입한다'고 했으므로 불일치
det.tip: 색상으로 관객과 소통(일치). 나머지는 본문을 뒤집은 함정입니다.

ch: 소녀가 사는 지루한 마을은 다양한 색으로, 마법의 세계는 흑백으로 표현된다.
감독은 색상을 사용해 관객과 효과적으로 소통한다.
관객은 색의 차이로는 사건이 어느 세계에서 일어나는지 구분할 수 없다.
이 영화의 관객은 마법의 세계에 전혀 몰입하지 못한다.

questions.passage: Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who ①<u>comes</u> down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people ②<u>wears</u> colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes ③<u>misunderstood</u> and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture ④<u>blows</u> in the wind like snow.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② wears → wear: 주어 the people이 복수이므로 복수 동사 wear
det.analysis:
① comes: 'a man ~ who comes down to a town'에서 선행사 a man(단수)에 맞는 단수 동사 comes가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② wears → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'each house is painted differently, and the people ___ colorful clothes'에서 주어는 the people(사람들, 복수)이에요. 그래서 복수 동사 wear로 써야 해요. wears(단수)로 쓰면 주어와 수가 안 맞아 틀려요. ❌ wears는 틀림 ←정답

③ misunderstood: 'as he becomes misunderstood and disliked'에서 그가 '오해받게 되는' 수동의 뜻이라 과거분사 misunderstood가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ blows: 'ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind'에서 주어 ice powder(단수)에 맞는 단수 동사 blows가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 복수 주어 the people + 복수 동사 wear: 주어-동사 수 일치

questions.passage: Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 색상은 관객들의 감정을 강화하는데, 이는 강한 심리적 '무엇'을 불러일으키는 능력 때문인지 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 본문 'Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions.'에서 색상이 관객의 감정을 강화하는 것은 강한 '심리적 반응(psychological reactions)'을 불러일으키는 능력 때문이라고 했다. 따라서 빈자리에 들어갈 답은 psychological reactions다.
det.tip: due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions에서 psychological reactions를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 애니메이션 영화 초반에 남성 캐릭터는 자신의 진정한 힘을 숨긴 채 마치 '평범한 사람'인 것처럼 일하고 있다. 작은따옴표 안 '평범한 사람'에 해당하는 영어 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (3단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 본문 'He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power.'에서 그는 마치 '평범한 사람(an ordinary person)'인 것처럼 일한다고 했다. 'ordinary'는 본문에 여러 번 나오지만, '평범한 사람'을 뜻하는 정확한 세 단어 표현은 an ordinary person이다.
det.tip: working as if he were an ordinary person에서 an ordinary person을 찾습니다.

questions.passage: There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after __________ (be) swept away in a flash by a tornado. The world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'after ___ swept away'에서 after는 전치사예요. 전치사 뒤에는 동사를 명사처럼 쓰는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요. 게다가 소녀는 토네이도에 '휩쓸리는' 대상이라 수동의 뜻이 필요해요. 그래서 '동명사 + 수동'인 being swept away(휩쓸린 후에)로 써야 하므로 be를 being으로 바꿉니다.
det.tip: 전치사(after) + 동명사 수동태: after being swept away(휩쓸린 뒤에)

questions.passage: Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 색상이 영화의 메시지를 강렬하게 전달하고, 감정을 강화하며, 이야기를 이해하도록 돕고, 캐릭터의 여정을 보여주는 여러 방식을 예로 드는 것이 글 전체의 주제 ← 정답

❌ ② 붉은 외투 영화는 하나의 예시일 뿐, 전쟁 영화의 역사가 주제가 아님

❌ ③ 색상 기술·촬영 장비는 본문에서 다루지 않음

❌ ④ 영화감독이 되기 위한 전공 지식은 글의 초점이 아님
det.tip: 메시지 전달·감정·이야기 이해·여정을 관통하는 것은 '영화 속 색상의 역할'입니다.

ch: 영화에서 색상이 메시지 전달·감정 강화·이야기 이해·캐릭터 여정 표현에 쓰이는 방식
제2차 세계 대전 당시 나치의 잔혹성을 고발한 전쟁 영화들의 역사
애니메이션 영화를 제작할 때 필요한 색상 기술과 촬영 장비
영화감독이 되기 위해 반드시 갖추어야 할 미술 전공 지식

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 색상이 이야기와 감정 전달에 핵심 역할을 한다고 하므로 '관련 없다'는 반대

❌ ② 본문 'These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made'에서 '무작위가 아니라 의도적'이라고 했으므로 반대

✅ ③ 색상이 의도적으로 선택되어 메시지를 전달하고 감정·이야기를 효과적으로 표현한다는 글 전체의 핵심 메시지와 일치 ← 정답

❌ ④ 색상보다 연기력이 전부라는 내용은 본문에 없음
det.tip: intentionally made + convey message + impact emotion(의도적 선택으로 메시지·감정 전달)이 요지입니다.

ch: 영화의 색상은 단순한 장식일 뿐 이야기와는 관련이 없다.
영화감독은 색상을 무작위로 선택해 우연한 효과를 노린다.

좋은 영화는 색상보다 배우의 연기력에 전적으로 좌우된다.

questions.passage: At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much happier. __________. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"영화감독들은 우리에게 가능한 최상의 경험을 제공하기 위해 색상을 선택한다." (11단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) best, choose, colors, directors, experience, film, give, possible, the, to, us 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience
det.analysis:
'영화감독들은 ~ 색상을 선택한다'가 문장의 큰 뼈대예요. 주어는 '영화감독들'이라 Film directors로, 동사는 '선택한다'라서 choose로 써요: Film + directors + choose + colors.

'우리에게 ~을 제공하기 위해'는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사로 써요. '주다(제공하다)'는 give, '우리에게'는 us예요: to + give + us.

'가능한 최상의 경험'은 the best possible experience로 써요: the + best + possible + experience.

순서대로 이으면 Film / directors / choose / colors / to / give / us / the / best / possible / experience.
det.tip: 주어(Film directors) + 동사(choose colors) + 목적(to give us the best possible experience)

questions.wa: Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience
accept: Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience
